description: Exploratory paired sweep of the cert-void backfill size below the RB's own capacity: the capacity a no-cert Ranking Block contributes to the W20 standard window, from half an RB down to zero. At zero a certless block adds neither usage nor capacity, so between certs the window reads the fills of the EBs still inside it, and a window that loses its last EB reads utilisation 0. The recommended design (RB-sized contribution) is the base arm; the earlier void-size-sweep showed everything above RB-sized loses monotonically on launch day. Urgent controller stays W5; everything else fixed at S=.75/U=.50, D16, half-RB threshold, K10. Five paired seeds across the five headline loads; directional only, not confirmatory evidence.
